about: Named test drives for tools/test/drive_route.py and tools/test/run-drive.sh. Waypoints in Unreal metres (x, y), snapped to the nearest lane (30 m at most) and linked along the lanes. max_kmh caps the lane limits. Coordinates match L_City_RueDeLaRepublique (tools/city/traffic.py, focus rue-de-la-republique).

drives.name: grolee-cordeliers
drives.description: Rue Grolée to place des Cordeliers and rue Champier: straight street then one junction.

drives.name: hopital-bellecour
drives.description: Place de la République, rue Bellecordière, rue de la Barre, place Bellecour, rue Édouard Herriot: the longest drive of the quarter, bends and four junctions.

drives.name: gentil-bourse
drives.description: Rue Gentil then rue de la Bourse to rue du Bât d'Argent: short drive with a right turn.
